name: Azad Engineering Ltd
title: Azad Engineering Ltd - 544061 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Azad's FY26 revenue rose ~30% to INR590 cr with 36.9% EBITDA, but capacity is ramping from a low base: inventory is building, receivables sit at INR309 cr, and the 25%+ growth guide is held without new numbers.

utilisation.quote: we were around 50%, 60% of the capacity machines were inside. And when we cut the ribbon, we start producing the parts the same day.

capex.quote: we are on the trajectory to ramp up the upcoming plants

triggers.label: Inventory days target 200 → 160-170
triggers.quote: you will see a drastic change coming to closer to 200 days. And H2, we get down to 160, 170 days.

triggers.label: Capex deployment ~INR180-190 cr balance
triggers.quote: INR180 crores to INR190 crores will be coming there

triggers.label: Order book ~INR6,500 cr, 11-12x revenue
triggers.quote: Our order book is at approximately INR6,500 crores with INR600 crores delivered in FY '26

triggers.label: 25%+ top-line growth reiterated
triggers.quote: delivering on our previously communicated top line growth of approximately 25% plus for the current year

guidance.quote: delivering on our previously communicated top line growth of approximately 25% plus for the current year

guidance.value: ~200 days in H1 FY27, 160-170 days in H2
guidance.quote: you will see a drastic change coming to closer to 200 days. And H2, we get down to 160, 170 days.
INR180 crores to INR190 crores will be coming there

prior_guidance_check.quote: a healthy year-on-year growth of over 32%

red_flags.label: Inventory build; 'not fully utilized' bill discounting
red_flags.quote: We have not fully utilized receivable bill discounting facility this year given the current cost dynamics

red_flags.label: Receivables INR309 cr; GST credit ~INR100 cr stuck till H1 FY28
red_flags.quote: we expected to realize by H1 FY '28

red_flags.label: Saudi capex timelines shifted
red_flags.quote: the time lines have been shifted

red_flags.label: Guidance commitment softened to 'approximately' with no numbers beyond FY27
red_flags.quote: we would only give a growth number

evasions.quote: Yes. So as we gave a statement in the last call also, '26 was something

evasions.quote: this is a single contract and you're asking us specific information on the contract. It will be difficult to share.
